question: Does Bobby approve merging this pinned reusable-workflow caller after a redacted non-publishing runtime demonstration confirms the intended secret and permission boundary?
rationale: The repository contract reserves merge approval to Bobby, and this workflow intentionally delegates execution while forwarding credentials.

options.title: Approve after runtime proof
